verifications.claim: The Artemis II splashdown returns astronauts from the moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "four astronauts of NASA’s Artemis II mission had achieved ... a historic return to human spaceflight around the moon"; "first humans toward the Moon since 1972"; "first humans to fly on a moon mission"; "After venturing farther into space ... around the far side of the moon."
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly describe the mission as a return from a moon flyby/orbit, supporting the claim precisely.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II splashdown occurs on April 10, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Floating in the Pacific Ocean on Friday ... mission began on April 1"; "April 10, 2026"; URL paths include "/2026/04/10/"
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state or imply the date as April 10, 2026, matching the 10-day mission from April 1 launch.
